# Paddington Central

> > Paddington Central is a mixed-use commercial campus in London offering sustainable office space, retail, dining, and green spaces alongside the Grand Union Canal, developed by British Land.

The campus features multiple office buildings including 2 Kingdom Street, 4 Kingdom Street, and 1 Sheldon Square, with excellent transport links via the Elizabeth Line and Paddington station. British Land's development emphasizes sustainability, carbon reduction, and inclusive workspace design with BREEAM-certified buildings and community initiatives.
